newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain jails 15 for arson attacks, explosives.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain jails 15 for arson attacks, explosives.

text.p: Bahrain's State Security Court has jailed 15 people for terms ranging from six months to five years for arson attacks and making and possessing explosives without permission, Bahraini newspapers said on Tuesday.

They said the court, whose judgement cannot be appealed against, jailed six people for torching a bakery and nine others for making and possessing explosives without permission and setting fire to a private car and a restaurant.

The court has sentenced around 156 people since Bahrain's government, seeking to speed up judgements, ordered it in March to try hundreds of detainees held for street protests, sabotage and arson attacks.

Around 27 people, including three policemen and seven Bangladeshis, have been killed since anti-government unrest broke out in December 1994 with members of the Shi'ite Moslem community seeking political and economic reforms.
